title: Without the permission Work In Progress is absent from the reports navigation
custom_preconds:
1. A test user exists whose role does NOT have the permission that grants access to Work In Progress reports (assign the Tech user such a role; restore the original role afterward).
2. You are signed in as that user on a desktop browser.
custom_steps:
1. Open the reports navigation.
2. Look for "Work In Progress" under the Performance group.
custom_expected: 1. The report does not appear in the navigation for this user.
